description: This file contains API functions for authentication-related operations such as registration, login, token refresh, and logout. It handles extracting and normalizing tokens from different backend response formats and interfaces with the backend API endpoints.

methods.name: extractTokens
methods.description: Extracts access and refresh tokens from various possible backend response formats.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Removes 'Bearer' prefix from tokens to normalize their format before storage.

methods.name: registerApplicant
methods.description: Public function to register a new applicant user by sending a POST request to the backend.

methods.name: loginStep1
methods.description: Performs login by validating credentials, handling token extraction, and storing tokens.

methods.name: refreshTokens
methods.description: Refreshes the tokens by sending the refresh token to the server and updating stored tokens.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Revokes the refresh token to log the user out.
